</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">count == len(instances)</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">If no instance is visible, return exactly:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">{"count": 0, "instances": []}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">Think carefully before answering. Output JSON only. Do not use Markdown fences or add explanations.</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">CAPTION1</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are given a full image with one highlighted red rectangular region.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Describe **only the visual content inside the highlighted region and never mention the rest of the image.** Use the rest of the image only as context.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">The pipeline has pre-selected one anchor object inside this region (localization metadata only):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">"{anchor}"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">ANCHOR-CENTERED ORGANIZATION (same convention as the zoomed view): treat this anchor as the primary reference point of the description, not as its exclusive scope. First identify the anchor and state every attribute of it that is discernible at this scale, then cover its immediate neighborhood, then the rest of the region. Whenever visually supported, express other objects’ positions relative to this anchor. The anchor phrase is localization metadata only: never copy an attribute, text, count, or relation from the phrase unless you can independently see it in the image. If several objects match the phrase, describe each of them and say the reference is ambiguous; if you cannot confidently locate the referent, say so and describe the region normally. The anchor never shrinks your coverage duty: everything else plainly visible in the region must still be described.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">YOUR CAPTION DEFINES WHAT THE FULL-IMAGE VIEW CAN SEE. A later stage compares this caption against a zoomed-in description of exactly the same region and treats every attribute you omitted as "not visible at full-image scale". The zoomed description follows the same spatial and inclusion rules as this one; the only intended difference between the two descriptions is resolution. Omitting something that is in fact plainly visible therefore corrupts the comparison. Be exhaustive about everything you can genuinely discern at this scale, and explicit about what you cannot.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">EXHAUSTIVENESS CONTRACT (work from large to small):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">- For every large or prominent object in the region — especially people — state ALL attributes that are plainly discernible at this scale: garment types and their colors (shirt, pants, dress, hat, shoes), object colors and materials, obvious pose or action, obviously identifiable held or attached items, and coarse spatial relations between the described objects. A large foreground person whose shirt color is obvious must have that shirt color stated.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">- Then cover mid-sized objects the same way.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">- For small objects and fine details (small text, small items, precise counts, subtle patterns, distant faces), report what is discernible and explicitly say "unclear" or "not readable at this scale" for the rest. Saying unclear is valuable signal; silently skipping is not.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not compress multiple distinct objects into one vague summary sentence when their individual attributes are visible.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">- When several instances of one category are present (price tags, signs, windows), bind each described instance to a stable qualifier — attachment or nearest-object relation, a part location on its host, or an explicit image-frame position — instead of the bare category noun.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES&gt;&gt;&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">PERSON ORIENTATION: before naming a person’s own left/right body side or a side-specific held item, state which way that person faces and derive the side per the contract above. When the facing is not discernible at this scale, use viewer wording (’the hand on the viewer’s left’) or say the side is unclear; never guess an anatomical side.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">RECTANGLE-EDGE POLICY (aligned with the zoomed view): the rectangle boundary is an artificial viewport, not photographed scene content. For a discrete object that crosses the boundary, apply exactly one branch:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- If it cannot be confidently identified, or no complete part of it lies inside the region, omit it entirely.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- If it is clearly identifiable and at least one of its parts is completely visible inside the region, you MAY describe exactly those fully visible parts and their discernible attributes; say "unclear" for their small details. Never state whole-object attributes, whole-body actions, or totals for such an object, and never describe the part outside the region even though the full image shows it — it is outside this region’s scope.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">- Never mention the clipping itself anywhere in the caption: no "partially visible", "cut off", or "at the edge" wording. Describe what is inside, say unclear for what is too small, and stay silent about the rest.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- Large scene surfaces or structures may be described when a substantial, meaningful portion lies inside the region; do not describe their truncation.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">Before returning the caption, perform a mandatory deletion check: remove every sentence that mentions the rectangle boundary or an object’s clipped state.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px2.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">If a small detail is not readable at this scale, explicitly say it is unclear. Do not guess counts, text, colors, or actions that are not visually clear.</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">CAPTION2</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are given an image crop constructed around one selected anchor object.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Selected anchor object (localization metadata only):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">"{anchor}"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.6.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Write a detailed natural-language caption organized around this selected anchor and its visible neighborhood. Treat the anchor as the primary reference point, not as the exclusive scope of the caption.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">Coverage and organization:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.9.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">- First describe the selected anchor itself in detail, including every clearly visible part, content, marking, readable text, color, attribute, condition, or action that belongs to it.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">- Then describe every other clearly visible object and detail in the image. Do not omit reliable visual information merely because it is not part of the anchor.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">- Whenever visually supported, express each other object’s relationship to the anchor, preferring frame-free devices: attached to it, contained in it, on it, nearest to it, or beside it at the same depth. When a direction word is needed, it must follow the SPATIAL FRAME CONTRACT below: left/right between objects are the viewer’s (write ’to the viewer’s left of the anchor’, never the anchor’s own left/right), above/below are image-vertical, front/behind may only name the intrinsic sides of a person, animal, or vehicle whose facing you have stated, and any depth difference is written as closer to / farther from the camera.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">- If no reliable relationship to the anchor can be established, still describe the visible object with a neutral location within this crop. Never invent a relationship merely to connect it to the anchor.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">- DEPTH ZONES (mandatory): this crop is a 2D window that may span very different scene depths. For every non-anchor object you describe, make its depth relation to the anchor explicit: in the anchor’s own depth zone, clearly closer to the camera than the anchor, or clearly farther from the camera. Never say an object is near, beside, or next to the anchor when it merely appears close in the 2D frame while lying at a clearly different depth (e.g. a foreground jogger inside a crop built around a distant lighthouse is ’much closer to the camera than the lighthouse’, never ’near the lighthouse’).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">- The anchor phrase above is only localization metadata. Do not copy or assume any attribute, text, identity, or full-scene relationship from that phrase unless it is independently visible in this image.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES&gt;&gt;&gt;&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT&gt;&gt;&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">PERSON ORIENTATION AND HANDS (mandatory):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.18.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.18.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">- Before describing any person’s pose, clothing sides, held objects, or body-part sides, state which way that person faces: toward the camera, away from the camera, toward the image-left, toward the image-right, or ’facing unclear’ when it cannot be determined.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.19.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.19.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">- POSE BEFORE SIDE: when two limbs of one person must be told apart, prefer a pose or state descriptor that needs no laterality at all — the raised arm versus the arm hanging at the side, the hand gripping the strap, the gloved hand, the arm resting on the table. Such wording is unambiguous for any viewer and stays true regardless of facing.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.20.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.20.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">- Name an anatomical side only when a pose descriptor cannot separate the limbs AND the person’s facing is unmistakable at this resolution (their face, or their back, is plainly readable — not inferred from a few pixels of hair or shoulder). Then derive the side from that stated facing per the frame contract and include the viewer-side derivation in parentheses so it is checkable, for example: ’He faces away from the camera; his right hand (on the viewer’s right) holds a silver can.’</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.21.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.21.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">- If the facing is not unmistakable, never write ’left hand’ or ’right hand’: write the pose descriptor, or ’one hand (laterality unclear)’ plus a viewer-frame location. A small or distant person is exactly the case where a confident side claim is unsafe.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.22.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.22.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- Whenever you describe what one hand holds, account for the other hand in the same pass: either describe what it visibly holds (or that it is visibly empty), or record it in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section as out of view with unknown content.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">INSTANCE LOCKING FOR REPEATED OBJECTS:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- When the crop shows, or plausibly extends into, more than one instance of a category — price tags, labels, signs, screens, windows, wheels, hands, shoes, bags, and similar repeated items — never attach information to the bare category noun. Bind every described instance to a stable qualifier that would remain valid in the full image: an attachment or nearest-object relation (’the mug nearest the kettle’), or a part location on its host (’on the tail of the aircraft’).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.26.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.26.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">- A position in this frame is NOT such a qualifier and never counts as one. This crop is a window cut out of a larger photograph and its borders are not the photograph’s borders: whatever is leftmost, rightmost, or ’on the left side’ HERE can sit dead centre, or on the opposite side, of the full image. Never write a frame superlative — leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right — about anything in any wording: you cannot see what lies outside this crop, so you cannot know that anything in it is the outermost one.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.27.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.27.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">- When a rough position genuinely helps a reader picture the scene, word it as local to this crop (’in the left part of this crop’), never as a fact about the image. An instance with no attachment or part qualifier is described without one and recorded in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section, not pinned by position.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.28" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.29" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.29.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.29.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">Include useful details such as objects, readable text, colors, attributes, actions, and spatial relationships. There is no required schema, bullet format, or fixed wording; organize the description naturally.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.30" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.31" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">Base every statement only on visual evidence in this crop:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.32" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.32.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.32.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">- HONEST EDGE REPORTING: the four outer crop edges are artificial viewport boundaries, not photographed scene content. When an object is cut off by an outer edge (the anchor included), simply say what you see: describe its clearly visible parts and their attributes, and never state whole-object attributes, whole-body actions, totals, or overall shape/size for it, and never guess what continues beyond the edge. Keep the main description positive — what IS visible — and put every cut-off / partially-visible / out-of-view remark in the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section at the end instead. A truncated object you cannot even identify belongs only in that section.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.33" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.33.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.33.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p33" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p33.1" class="ltx_p">- For text, use a deliberately conservative, character-by-character standard. A character is clearly legible only when its complete glyph shape and boundaries are visible and there is no reasonable alternative reading; prefer a shorter certain transcription over a longer plausible one, and never use language, brand, or scene context to complete a word. If the entire inscription meets this standard, transcribe it exactly. Otherwise never guess the uncertain characters: when a contiguous substring of at least three characters is clearly legible, report only that substring, say the rest is unclear, and state where it sits (its character count and whether it is the beginning, end, or middle). Call it a beginning or ending only when that text boundary is itself visible in the crop, and say whether the character touching the uncertain side has a complete isolated glyph — under cropping, occlusion, blur, or small scale such boundary characters are unreliable. If the sign, panel, or surface carrying an inscription is itself cut off by the crop edge at or near the text region, treat the inscription as partial with the cut side uncertain even when every visible glyph is complete — the crop is not a god’s-eye view and the text may continue on the hidden part. Never attribute text to an object unless it is visibly printed on that object. TEXT COLOR CAUTION: outlined or two-tone glyphs are easily misread at this scale — dark characters with a light outline routinely look like white text on a dark panel. State a text color only when the stroke FILL color is unambiguous; when uncertain, write ’light-colored text on a dark panel’ or ’dark text on a light panel’, or omit the color entirely. A guessed text color must never appear.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.34" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.34.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.34.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">  FIGURE AND GROUND: a panel’s color is never the glyphs’ color. Name the color of the strokes and the color of the surface they sit on as two separate facts (’red characters on a yellow panel’), and never let one stand in for the other. Watch multi-tone signs especially: a fascia whose left panel is green and whose right panel is white has TWO panel colors and neither of them is a text color, so writing ’white letters’ for black letters on its white panel is the same error as guessing. Illuminated night signage is where this goes wrong most.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.35" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">- COUNTING-SCOPE POLICY: do not state an exact number merely because N instances happen to be visible in this crop. An exact count is allowed only in one of these two cases:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.36" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.36.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.36.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.36.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">  (A) ANCHOR-OWNED SET: the counted items are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor, and the complete anchor-side set relevant to the count is visible.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.37" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.37.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.37.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">  (B) FULLY CLOSED ANCHOR-RELATIVE REGION: the counted items lie in a finite interval or region defined by the selected anchor and another specific visible object, and every boundary needed to delimit that region is fully visible in the crop. The crop edges must never serve as those boundaries.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.38" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.38.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.38.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">  Phrases such as near, around, behind, in front of, to the left/right of, in the background, in the water, on the beach, or on the road merely locate visible instances; they do not close a counting set. Sea, water, beach, road, field, sky, crowd, and other surfaces or scene regions that continue beyond the crop are open sets, even when every instance currently visible in the crop is sharp and separable. For an open set, use non-numeric wording such as ’several are visible’ when useful, and state that the exact scene total cannot be determined from the crop. Never estimate or give a range.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.39" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.39.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.39.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p39.1" class="ltx_p">- Do not infer hidden parts or use world knowledge to fill gaps. Describe uncertain details as unclear.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.40" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.41" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.41.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.41.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">End the caption with a final section exactly titled ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES:’. It is a short bullet inventory whose only purpose is to warn later stages which references would be ambiguous or open; it is not a description and can never be quoted as visual evidence:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.42" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.42.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.42.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">- List each same-category counterpart whose content is unknown because it is cut off by a crop edge, out of view, or occluded: the other hand of a person when you described one hand, additional price tags/labels/signs beyond the ones you fully described, the unseen remainder of a vehicle or large object when you described one of its parts.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.43" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.43.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.43.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.43.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p43" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p43.1" class="ltx_p">- Each note records only: the entity class and its owner or host (’the man’s other hand’, ’additional price tags’, ’the rest of the blue trailer’), its status (cut off at which edge, out of view, or occluded), and ’content unknown’ when applicable.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.44" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.44.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.44.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p44.1" class="ltx_p">- Notes must NEVER contain attributes, colors, counts, actions, or transcribed text, and must never guess what the hidden content might be.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.45" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.45.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.45.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.45.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px3.p1.p45.1" class="ltx_p">- If nothing qualifies, end with exactly ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES: none.’</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">CAPTION2_ANCHOR_MARKED</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A thin red selection rectangle has been added to this crop because the crop contains multiple objects of the same category. It marks the one specific instance named as the selected anchor object in the instructions below. Use the rectangle silently to distinguish that photographed object, its parts, contents, markings, and related nearby objects from those belonging to other same-category objects. Then write the caption as if the artificial rectangle were absent. Never mention, describe, count, transcribe, or treat the rectangle, its color, shape, position, corners, or boundary as photographed content. Refer to the selected photographed object naturally, for example by its object category and visible scene position.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS3.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
