<section id="A10.SS4" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.4 </span>Incremental evidence and bilingual QA generation</h3>

<section id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">INCREMENT</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Two descriptions of the SAME image region are given. caption1 was written while seeing the full image (the region was highlighted with a box). caption2 was written while seeing a high-resolution crop of exactly that region. Both captions were given the same selected anchor phrase and were asked to organize around that anchor, so ’the anchor’ in either caption denotes the same photographed object; use that shared reference to align object identities between them.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Selected anchor object:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">"{anchor}"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">The phrases ’selected object’, ’selected anchor’, ’marked object’, or ’outlined object’ in caption2 refer to this exact photographed anchor, not to a newly appearing object. Use this metadata only to align object identity between the two captions. Do not merge a different same-category object with the selected anchor. If an object’s identity cannot be aligned reliably, omit that candidate fact. Any selection rectangle, outline, box, marker, label, or annotation mentioned by caption2 is pipeline metadata, not photographed content, and must never become an incremental fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">Extract the incremental facts: discrete, visually verifiable information that caption2 provides and caption1 either omits (absent), marks as unclear (unclear), or states differently (contradicted). Contradictions ARE increments: report them with relation "contradicted" and record caption1’s claim.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">MANDATORY CROP-VIEWPORT INVARIANCE CHECK (higher priority than treating contradictions as increments): every retained fact must describe the photographed scene or an object’s intrinsic property, and must remain semantically true if the crop were expanded. The crop is not a privileged or god’s-eye view of the scene; it merely hides content beyond its four artificial edges. A difference in how much of an object falls inside the crop is NEVER an absent, unclear, or contradicted scene fact. Reject any candidate based on an object being at a crop edge, cut off, cropped, only partially visible, or reduced to particular visible body parts by the crop. For example, if caption1 describes a person walking while caption2 says only the person’s head and shoulders are visible at the bottom edge, these claims do NOT contradict each other: caption2 is reporting viewport truncation, so omit the candidate entirely. Apply this rule even if caption2 states the boundary observation confidently and even if it can be assigned one of the allowed fact types. Silently audit every proposed fact for crop-edge dependence before adding it to the JSON.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES handling: caption2 may end with a section titled ’VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES’. That section is disambiguation context ONLY. Never extract a fact from it, never quote it in whole or in part as source_from_caption2, and never let it add, upgrade, or contradict main-description content. Use it solely to stay aware that other same-category instances or hidden parts exist with unknown content.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">REFERENT QUALIFIER PRESERVATION: when a caption2 evidence sentence pins an instance with a qualifier — an anatomical side (’in his right hand’), a stated facing direction, an attachment or nearest-object relation (’the mug nearest the kettle’), a part location on a host (’on the tail of the aircraft’), or a depth-zone tag (’much closer to the camera than the anchor’) — the fact’s statement MUST keep that qualifier. Dropping the qualifier and attributing the information to the bare category (’the man holds a can’, ’the price tag reads 140’) is forbidden, because other instances may exist beyond the crop. Never flip an anatomical side into a viewer side or vice versa when restating evidence; parenthetical viewer-side derivations from caption2 may be omitted from the statement, but the anatomical side itself must be preserved exactly.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">SPATIAL-FRAME CONFLICTS ARE NOT INCREMENTS: both captions follow the same frame contract (anatomical body sides derived from stated facing; viewer frame between objects; no depth ’behind’). If the two captions disagree ONLY about which body side of the same person carries an item or pose (left vs right hand/arm/leg/shoulder), and caption2 states the person’s facing with a derivation while caption1 does not, treat caption2’s side as a corrected relabeling of the same observation: do NOT emit the side flip itself as a contradicted fact, and never create a fact whose main content is which body side something is on. Silently use caption2’s side inside any other fact about that item.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">CAPTION1 OMISSION GUARD (applies to relation ’absent’ only): caption1 is written at full-image scale but may still simply forget an obvious attribute. When caption1 clearly describes an object as large or prominent within the region — for example a person occupying much of it — and the candidate fact states a coarse attribute any full-image viewer would plainly see (dominant clothing color or garment type, overall object color, coarse pose, obvious ongoing action), treat the missing attribute as a caption1 omission, NOT an increment, and omit the fact. Keep ’absent’ facts only for genuinely fine-grained information: small text, small parts or accessories, precise counts, subtle patterns, small held items, or details whose visibility plausibly requires zooming in. This guard never applies to facts whose relation is ’unclear’ (caption1 explicitly could not see it) or ’contradicted’ (caption1 made a different claim).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">Only keep facts of these types: count, OCR text, color, action, local attribute, spatial relation. Discard:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">- subjective wording and anything hedged with "possibly/maybe";</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- texture-only remarks (foliage, grass, sky, water, lighting);</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- facts about the region boundary itself (what is inside/outside the box, objects cut by the crop edge);</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">- range counts ("15-20") and estimates;</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- hue-level color differences (red vs orange, cyan vs blue) — keep a color contradiction only if the two claims are clearly different color classes.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">COUNT FACT ELIGIBILITY (mandatory and higher priority than contradiction):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">- Retain an exact count only when it belongs to exactly one of two scope types: (A) anchor_owned — items that are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor; or (B) closed_anchor_relative_region — items inside a finite region explicitly bounded by the selected anchor and another specific object, with all boundaries fully visible in caption2.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">- The artificial crop boundary never closes a set. Relative words such as near, around, behind, in front of, left/right of, in the background, in water, or on a beach/road/field are locators, not complete boundaries. A visible subset of people or objects on a sea, beach, road, field, sky, crowd, or other region that may continue beyond the crop is not an exact scene count. Reject it even if caption2 gives a confident number and even if caption1 gives a different number.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">- For every retained count fact, add count_scope_type (anchor_owned or closed_anchor_relative_region), counted_entity, scope_boundary_description, and scope_fully_visible=true. If you cannot truthfully fill all four fields from caption2, omit the count fact. For non-count facts, use null for these fields.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">OCR evidence rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p33" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p33.1" class="ltx_p">- TYPE DISCIPLINE: any fact whose statement reports readable characters, letters, digits, words, logo text, or an inscription MUST use type ’OCR text’ with all audit fields filled. Never type a text-reading fact as attribute, local attribute, or color — doing so would smuggle it past every OCR boundary rule.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">- Preserve caption2’s exact certainty boundary. If caption2 says only a substring is legible, label the fact as partial OCR text and preserve the exact substring, its character count, and its stated position.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">- A partial OCR fact is eligible only when it contains at least three contiguous clearly legible characters and caption2 identifies a usable position for that substring.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">- Never fill in, repair, normalize, or guess unclear characters. Never turn a partial substring into a claim about the full inscription, word, brand, or name.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">- If caption2 transcribes a sequence but also says the inscription extends into a cropped or obscured side, treat it as partial OCR even when the visible sequence itself is described as clear. Preserve which side is uncertain and whether the boundary-adjacent glyph is fully isolated.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">- For every OCR fact, add these audit fields: ocr_scope (full or partial), visible_sequence (the exact transcribed characters), uncertain_side (left, right, top, bottom, both, internal, none, or unknown), and boundary_character_isolated (a JSON boolean true or false, never a quoted string). If any portion of the same inscription, sign, label, or printed text is described as cropped, obscured, incomplete, or unclear, ocr_scope MUST be partial. Set boundary_character_isolated to true only when caption2 explicitly confirms that the glyph touching the uncertain side is complete and visibly separated on both sides; otherwise use false.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p39.1" class="ltx_p">- For every OCR fact, also express the evidence relative to NORMAL READING ORDER rather than only to image geometry. Set substring_position to full when the complete inscription is visible, prefix when the visible sequence is the beginning of a longer inscription, suffix when it is the ending, or unknown when caption2 does not support that decision. Set unsafe_boundary to beginning or end when the corresponding boundary character of visible_sequence touches an uncertain region; use both, internal, none, or unknown when appropriate. Do not trim visible_sequence yourself. Physical top/bottom/left/right and sequence beginning/end are different concepts.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.40" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">Output strict JSON only:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">{"incremental_facts": [{"type": "...", "statement": "...", "source_from_caption2": "...", "ocr_scope": "full|partial|null", "visible_sequence": "...|null", "uncertain_side": "left|right|top|bottom|both|internal|none|unknown|null", "substring_position": "full|prefix|suffix|unknown|null", "unsafe_boundary": "beginning|end|both|internal|none|unknown|null", "boundary_character_isolated": false, "count_scope_type": "anchor_owned|closed_anchor_relative_region|null", "counted_entity": "...|null", "scope_boundary_description": "...|null", "scope_fully_visible": true, "relation_to_caption1": "absent|unclear|contradicted", "caption1_claim": null}], "skip_reason": null}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p43" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p43.1" class="ltx_p">If there is no reliable increment — in particular if every candidate fact concerns only vegetation, sky, water, lighting, or generic texture — return an empty list with a short skip_reason.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.45" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.45.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p45.1" class="ltx_p">caption1:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p46" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p46.1" class="ltx_p">{caption1}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p48" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p48.1" class="ltx_p">caption2:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px1.p1.p49" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
