</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">QA_GENERATION</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are generating fine-grained visual QA from incremental facts.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">The anchor object (salient and uniquely locatable in the full image) is:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">"{anchor}"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Crop-local anchor rule:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">{local_anchor_rule}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">Incremental facts (information visible only when zooming into the region around the anchor; each has an evidence sentence from the zoomed-in caption):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">{facts}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">Full zoomed-view description of the region (use it to check for duplicate objects of the same category — NOT as a source of new facts):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">{caption2}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">Current generation target plus feedback from prior QA candidates for this SAME anchor:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">{retry_context}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">Generate up to {qa_per_anchor} questions.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">Every incremental fact has a source_fact_index. Return that exact integer for the one fact used by each QA. Copy evidence_sentence directly from that fact’s source_from_caption2 when available; otherwise use its statement.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">Question rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- Each answer must come from exactly one incremental fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">- When generating more than one QA in the same response, every QA must use a different source_fact_index and evidence sentence; never make two questions from the same fact or paraphrase the same question.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- Any question that asks the solver to read or transcribe text, letters, characters, digits, words, logo lettering, or a specified character span MUST use question_type=ocr. Never label such a question as attribute, comparison, or another type.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">- PRIORITY: if one or more eligible OCR facts are present, generate QA from those OCR facts before using count, attribute, action, or spatial facts. The incremental-facts list is ordered with OCR facts first.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">- Read the ENTIRE OCR fact, especially statement and source_from_caption2; do not treat visible_sequence as the only useful information. Visual details explicitly tied to the text—such as its background color, text color, position, orientation, containing panel, or relation to another label—are valuable referring cues. Prefer a question that uses those cues to identify one text region over a generic question that asks for every word on a whole sign or logo. Use a visual attribute as a locator, not as another requested answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">- A HEDGED IDENTITY IS NOT A REFERENT. When caption2 hedges what something is — ’what looks like a bird’, ’possibly a helmet’, ’某种容器’ — it is telling you it could not identify the object, and a referring expression built on that guess matches nothing when the guess is wrong: a solver hunting for a bird will never find the plastic bag it actually is. Drop the hedged noun and locate the thing by what IS certain — where it sits, what it is inside or attached to, its color and size (’the small white object on the ledge above the second window’). If nothing certain identifies it, skip the fact. Never carry the hedge into the question either: ’the shoe or boot’ tells a solver you are guessing.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">- LOCATOR ATTRIBUTE RELIABILITY: prefer host-level cues — panel/sign color, position, containing object, nearest landmark — over the text’s OWN color. Small text color is frequently misperceived (dark outlined glyphs read as white), and a wrong locator attribute misleads solvers or matches a different text region. Include the text’s color only when the fact states it without hedging AND it adds discrimination that the host cue does not already provide; when the panel alone is unique, leave the text color out. Never take a color from one region of a multi-tone sign and attach it to text sitting on another region; if you cannot say the stroke fill without hedging, use the host cue alone.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">- ONE HOST PER OCR ANSWER. The answer is text carried by a SINGLE bounded host — one sign, label, plate, panel, or printed line. Never assemble an answer out of characters sitting on separate objects, and never scope an OCR question by nearness to a GROUP (’the digits printed near the green bottles’, ’the letters around the potted plants’): proximity to a set has no boundary a solver can reproduce, so which characters belong in the answer becomes arbitrary and a second reader will include a different set. If the text you want spans separate hosts, ask about one of them instead.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">- OCR facts may contain deterministic fields computed by code: safe_sequence, safe_character_count, required_span, and qa_eligible. Never correct, repair, or invent characters beyond safe_sequence. The answer must be one clearly supported CONTIGUOUS segment of safe_sequence.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">- For a partial OCR fact (required_span=first or last), write a PLAIN text-reading question about that inscription, located by host-level cues, with the answer equal to safe_sequence verbatim. Do not add any span wording (no ’first/last k characters’), do not add totality words such as ’entire’, ’complete’, or ’all the text’, and never mention cropping or hidden characters. A dedicated edge-rewriting stage that sees the full photograph will rewrite such drafts into the final safe span wording; your draft only needs to pick the right inscription and copy safe_sequence.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p33" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p33.1" class="ltx_p">- LOCALIZED FULL-OCR SEGMENT: when required_span=full and the fact itself explicitly associates different complete words or consecutive word groups with independently identifiable visual regions, you may ask for one such region and use only its complete text as the answer. The chosen answer must be one or more WHOLE consecutive words appearing verbatim in safe_sequence; never take characters from inside a word. Both questions must include the fact-supported visual locator that isolates that segment. Do not invent a color, position, container, or relation. If the fact does not support a unique localized segment, use the complete safe_sequence instead.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.34" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.34.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.34.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">- Example: if a fact says that OPEN appears in white on an upper green panel and 24 HOURS appears on a separate lower black strip, prefer asking what text appears on the upper green panel (answer: OPEN), rather than what all text on the sign says. This example describes the policy only; never copy its objects, colors, positions, or text into another image’s QA.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.35" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">- For required_span=full, either ask for the complete clearly legible text and use safe_sequence verbatim, or apply LOCALIZED FULL-OCR SEGMENT exactly as defined above.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.36" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.36.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.36.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.36.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">- Never write view-dependent instructions such as ’excluding the top character’, ’ignore the cropped character’, ’remove the first visible letter’, or any reference to an image/crop boundary, cropping, truncation, or hidden characters. A fixed first/last k span must have the same answer in the full image and zoomed image.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.37" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.37.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.37.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">- Skip every OCR fact with qa_eligible=false or without all required deterministic fields.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.38" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.38.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.38.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">- If the context contains prior-candidate entries in addition to the generation_target_state, choose a DIFFERENT incremental fact and answer property. Do not repeat or merely paraphrase any rejected or retained global/crop question, evidence sentence, or source fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.39" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.39.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.39.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p39" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p39.1" class="ltx_p">- Use rejection feedback only to choose a better-supported candidate. NEVER alter the reference answer to imitate verifier outputs, and never invent a fact absent from the incremental-facts list.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.40" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.40.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.40.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">- If a previous candidate failed crop verification, prefer a different fact whose answer is larger/clearer and directly visible in the crop.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.41" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.41.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.41.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">- The generation_target_state entry in the context is authoritative. If zoom_required_still_needed=true and a previous accepted candidate was answerable from the full image, prefer a substantially smaller or finer detail marked absent/unclear/contradicted. If it is false, a retained full-image-answerable QA counts toward the accepted-question minimum; the next distinct accepted QA may be either full-image-answerable or zoom-required.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.42" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.42.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.42.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">- If retry feedback says a previous candidate remained ambiguous AFTER the dedicated image-aware referent repair failed, use a different uniquely referable target. Never add answer-leaking qualifiers.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.43" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.43.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.43.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.43.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p43" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p43.1" class="ltx_p">- DISAMBIGUATION: before writing each question, scan the full description above. If the answer object’s category could match more than one object in the crop (e.g. a ring worn by a person vs a standalone ring product image), the crop-local referring phrase MUST include a qualifier that separates them (position, size, displayed-vs-worn, color). If no crop-visible qualifier can make it unique, skip that fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.44" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p44.1" class="ltx_p">- Write TWO semantically paired versions of every question:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.45" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.45.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.45.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.45.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p45.1" class="ltx_p">  1. question_zh / question_en are GLOBAL questions for the original full image. They MUST make the answer object locatable in the full image by a solver who has never seen the crop. Choose the locator by the target’s REAL relation to the anchor (see GLOBAL LOCATOR POLICY below).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.46" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.46.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.46.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.46.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.46.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p46" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p46.1" class="ltx_p">  2. crop_question_zh / crop_question_en are LOCAL questions for the exact zoomed crop. Remove context that the crop itself cannot establish, such as "in the center of the plaza", "on the building in the background", or "to the right of the white building". Keep only qualifiers whose evidence is visible inside the crop and that are needed to identify the answer object there.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.47" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.47.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.47.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.47.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.47.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p47" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p47.1" class="ltx_p">- Follow the Crop-local anchor rule exactly. A selection rectangle may be used only as a referring-expression locator for the photographed anchor, its parts, contents, markings, or related nearby objects. Never ask about the rectangle itself, its color, shape, boundary, corners, or any artificial label. The GLOBAL questions must never mention a selection rectangle.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.48" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.48.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.48.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.48.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p48" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p48.1" class="ltx_p">- The GLOBAL and LOCAL versions MUST ask the same property of the same object and MUST have the same answer. The local version is not a new question.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.49" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.49.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.49.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.49.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p49" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p49.1" class="ltx_p">- The LOCAL question must be self-contained and its answer object must be uniquely identifiable inside the crop. If removing unavailable global context makes that impossible, skip the fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.50" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.50.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.50.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.51" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.51.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.51.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.51.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.51.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p51" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p51.1" class="ltx_p">GLOBAL LOCATOR POLICY (the crop is a 2D window; objects inside it can lie at completely different scene depths, so 2D adjacency inside the crop is NOT scene proximity):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.52" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.52.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.52.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.52.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.52.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p52" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p52.1" class="ltx_p">  (a) If the answer object has a REAL, visually supported scene relation to the anchor — it is a part of it, attached to it, on the same supporting surface, held by it, or genuinely adjacent at the same depth — locate it through the anchor phrase as usual.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.53" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.53.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.53.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.53.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.53.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p53" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p53.1" class="ltx_p">  (b) If the answer object is clearly at a different depth than the anchor (the zoomed description says it is much closer to or farther from the camera, e.g. a foreground jogger inside a crop built around a background lighthouse), NEVER claim proximity with words such as near, beside, next to, 附近, 旁边, and never use front/behind as a disguised depth word. That fabricates a relation that does not exist, misleads the solver into searching around the anchor, and reads unnaturally. PREFER KEEPING THE ANCHOR in the question through an HONEST relation — it is the verified, easiest-to-find landmark — choosing whichever of these reads naturally:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.54" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.54.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.54.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.54.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.54.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p54" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p54.1" class="ltx_p">      - CAMERA-AXIS relation (works for ANY anchor, including faceless structures; preferred when the target lies on or near the anchor’s line of sight, which crop co-membership usually guarantees): state the depth order along the viewing axis with the canonical wording — target closer to the camera: ’the yellow taxi between the clock tower and the camera’ / 在钟楼与镜头之间的黄色出租车; target farther: ’the brick warehouse beyond the red barge, farther from the camera’ / 越过红色驳船更远处的砖砌仓库. When the two do not overlap in the image, add a small image-frame offset word (’below the clock tower and between it and the camera’). This wording is honest 3D geometry, never a proximity claim.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.55" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.55.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.55.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.55.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.55.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p55" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p55.1" class="ltx_p">      - INTRINSIC ANCHOR-FRAME relation: when the anchor is a person, animal, or vehicle whose facing caption2 states, the target may be located in the anchor’s own frame with each side derived mechanically per the contract. Example: a cyclist riding toward the viewer has the deeper scene BEHIND him and his left-hand side on the viewer’s right, so ’the bright blue vertical sign behind the cyclist on his left-hand side’ is honest and natural. SIDE-BLINDNESS GUARDRAIL: verification models cannot reliably resolve a person’s left/right sides, so any anchor-frame directional clause is narrative scaffolding only — the question MUST still identify the target uniquely when that clause is ignored, through at least one anchor-independent discriminator (object type plus color, nearest fixed landmark, or viewer-frame position). If uniqueness would depend on the anchor-frame clause itself, do not use this option.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.56" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.56.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.56.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.56.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.56.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p56" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p56.1" class="ltx_p">      - EXPLICIT IMAGE-FRAME relation to the anchor: honest 2D wording such as ’in the image, above the cyclist in the background’ or ’below the lighthouse and much closer to the camera’, never wording that implies physical proximity.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.57" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.57.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.57.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.57.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.57.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p57" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p57.1" class="ltx_p">      - SELF-LOCATING referent (fallback when no anchor-linked wording reads naturally, e.g. the linkage would feel contrived across a large cluttered depth gap): drop the anchor and locate the target with full-image-frame position plus its own visible attributes, e.g. ’the jogger in the lower-center foreground of the image wearing a cap’. Depth words like foreground/closer to the camera stay true across views; horizontal words must be re-derived from the FULL image, never copied from the crop question.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.58" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.58.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.58.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.58.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.58.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p58" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p58.1" class="ltx_p">  (c) If none of these produces a referent you are confident is unique in the FULL image, skip the fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.59" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.59.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.59.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.59.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.59.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p59" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p59.1" class="ltx_p">  Prefer facts about the anchor itself or objects in its own depth zone: a crop-foreground object much closer to the camera is usually large and legible in the full image, so its facts rarely survive the full-image difficulty gate; spend them only when nothing anchored remains.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.60" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.60.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.60.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.61" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.61.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.61.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p61" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p61.1" class="ltx_p">- Example pair:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.62" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.62.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.62.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.62.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.62.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p62" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p62.1" class="ltx_p">  GLOBAL: "What text is written on the sign in the center of the plaza?"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.63" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.63.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.63.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p63" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p63.1" class="ltx_p">  LOCAL: "What text is written on the sign?"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.64" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.64.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.64.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.64.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.64.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p64" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p64.1" class="ltx_p">- NEVER put the answer attribute itself into either referring expression (if the answer is a color, the referring phrase must not mention that color).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.65" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.65.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.65.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.65.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.65.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p65" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p65.1" class="ltx_p">- The answer must be a single definite value: an exact count, one color word, a short text string, or a short action. Skip facts with ranges, hedges, or subjective wording.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.66" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.66.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.66.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.66.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.66.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p66" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p66.1" class="ltx_p">- The answer itself must never be an anatomical body side (’left hand’, ’right leg’) NOR a part location on an oriented object (’near the front left corner’, ’at the rear end’, 车头/车尾): all vision models share systematic mirror and orientation confusion, so such answers cannot be verified reliably. Sides and part locations serve only as referring qualifiers inside questions.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.67" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.67.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.67.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.67.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.67.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p67" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p67.1" class="ltx_p">- COUNTING SOURCE GATE: before using a count fact, classify its real-scene scope. It is eligible only as (A) anchor_owned: the counted items are parts of, attached to, worn by, held by, or contained in the selected anchor, with the complete relevant anchor-side set visible; or (B) closed_anchor_relative_region: the items occupy a finite interval or region explicitly bounded by the anchor and another specific visible object, and all boundaries are fully visible. If neither classification is supported, skip the fact, even when it contains an exact number and is contradicted by caption1.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.68" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.68.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.68.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.68.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.68.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p68" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p68.1" class="ltx_p">- Crop edges never close a counting scope. Phrases such as near, around, behind, in front of, left/right of, in the background, in water, or on a beach/road/field identify a visible subset but do not define a complete set. Never generate a question asking for the total of such an open scene region. In particular, counting the instances currently visible in a cropped slice of sea, beach, road, crowd, field, or sky is forbidden.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.69" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.69.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.69.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.69.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.69.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p69" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p69.1" class="ltx_p">- For an eligible anchor_owned count, the question must explicitly bind the counted items to the anchor. For an eligible closed_anchor_relative_region count, the question must name both bounding objects and the finite interval/region between them. A generic phrase such as ’behind the anchor’ is insufficient.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.70" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.70.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.70.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.70.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.70.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p70" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p70.1" class="ltx_p">- Prefer count facts carrying count_scope_type and scope_fully_visible=true. Independently audit the evidence and full crop description; metadata cannot rescue an actually open scope.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.71" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.71.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.71.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.71.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.71.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p71" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p71.1" class="ltx_p">- Skip facts about the region boundary and vegetation/sky texture.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.72" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.72.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.72.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.72.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.72.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p72" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p72.1" class="ltx_p">- Skip color facts that differ only at hue level between the two views.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.73" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.73.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.73.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.74" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.74.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.74.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.74.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.74.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p74" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p74.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES&gt;&gt;&gt;&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT&gt;&gt;&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.75" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.75.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.75.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.75.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.75.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p75" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p75.1" class="ltx_p">- Apply the frame contract above to every direction word in questions and answers. Body-part sides stay anatomical exactly as the fact states them (’right hand’ means his own right hand); never convert an anatomical side into an image side or vice versa. Keep parenthetical facing/viewer-side derivations OUT of the question text — questions carry only natural human phrasing.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.76" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.76.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.76.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.76.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.76.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p76" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p76.1" class="ltx_p">- BILINGUAL FRAME PARITY: the Chinese and English versions must encode the same frame with the same discipline. In Chinese, scene depth must be written as 背景中 / 前景中 / 离镜头更远 / 更靠近镜头 — NEVER as 后方、身后、前方 or 前面 attached to a person or animal (write 跑者背景中更远处的车辆, not 跑者后方的车辆). Use 身后/面前 only for a person’s intrinsic sides and only when the question itself states that person’s facing (e.g. 背对镜头的人身后). 左手/右手 are anatomical only, exactly like left/right hand in English.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.77" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.77.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.77.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.77.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.77.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p77" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p77.1" class="ltx_p">- LIMB QUALIFIER PREFERENCE: to single out one of a person’s paired limbs, prefer the pose or state the fact records — the raised arm, the arm hanging at the side, the hand holding the strap — over an anatomical side. Pose wording is natural, needs no facing derivation, and is the only kind a solver can check; verification models do not reliably resolve a person’s left from their right. Use ’left/right hand’ only when the fact states the side with an explicit facing derivation AND no pose descriptor separates the limbs.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.78" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.78.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.78.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.78.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.78.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p78" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p78.1" class="ltx_p">- REFERENT CLOSURE (mandatory): if the fact’s answer object belongs to a multi-instance category — hands, feet, shoes, price tags, labels, signs, screens, wheels, windows, bags, or similar repeated parts and products — and the zoomed description or its VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES indicate that other instances exist anywhere in the scene, are cut off, or are out of view with unknown content, then BOTH the global and crop questions MUST pin the exact instance using the qualifier carried by the fact and its evidence: the anatomical side (’in his right hand’), the attachment or nearest relation (’on the price tag closest to the kettle’), or the part location (’on the rear end of the large blue trailer’). A bare ’in his hand’, ’on the price tag’, ’on the sign’, or ’on the vehicle’ is forbidden in that situation. If the fact and evidence carry no such qualifier while the notes show counterparts exist, SKIP that fact.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.79" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.79.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.79.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.79.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.79.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p79" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p79.1" class="ltx_p">- Never mention the crop viewport, cropping, truncation, cut-off or out-of-view states, visibility limitations, or the VISIBILITY AND REFERENCE NOTES section in any question; the notes only tell you when an extra pinning qualifier is required. Positional image-frame references such as ’near the left edge of the image’ are locators, not viewport talk, and remain allowed under the frame contract.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.80" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.80.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.80.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.80.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.80.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p80" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p80.1" class="ltx_p">- FRAME CLAIMS COME FROM CAPTION1 ONLY. caption2 saw a crop, not the photograph, so any left/right/side wording in it describes the crop’s own frame and is worthless — often actively wrong — as a statement about the image: a crop taken from the right of the photo has its own left side. Never copy or paraphrase a horizontal position out of caption2 into a question. Use one only when caption1, which saw the whole photograph, places the target there, and word it as caption1 does.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.81" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.81.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.81.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.81.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.81.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p81" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p81.1" class="ltx_p">- NO FRAME SUPERLATIVES. Never write leftmost, rightmost, topmost, bottommost, far left, far right, 最左, 最右, 最上, 最下, 最顶, 最底 about the image in either language. Being the outermost of a category is a claim about everything in the photograph, which neither caption can establish; use an attachment, nearest-object, or part qualifier instead. A superlative INSIDE one named host stays fine (’the bottom word on the blue sign’), because the host bounds it.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.82" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.82.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.82.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.82.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.82.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p82" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p82.1" class="ltx_p">- After eligible OCR facts, prefer counting / attribute facts, and prefer facts whose relation_to_caption1 is "contradicted" or "unclear".</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.83" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.83.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.83.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p83" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p83.1" class="ltx_p">Output strict JSON only:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.84" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.84.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.84.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.84.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.84.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p84" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p84.1" class="ltx_p">{"qas": [{"question_zh": "...", "question_en": "...", "crop_question_zh": "...", "crop_question_en": "...", "answer": "...", "question_type": "counting|ocr|attribute|action|spatial|comparison", "evidence_sentence": "verbatim evidence", "source_fact_index": 0}]}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.85" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.85.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.85.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p85" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px2.p1.p85.1" class="ltx_p">If no fact qualifies, output {"qas": []}.</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">LOCAL_ANCHOR_RULE_UNMARKED</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

<section id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">LOCAL_ANCHOR_RULE_MARKED</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS4.SSS0.Px4.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">A thin red selection rectangle identifies the anchor in the crop. Both LOCAL questions MUST explicitly use the rectangle only as a locator, with wording such as ’the [object] inside the red selection rectangle’ / ’红框标出的[物体]’. If the fact concerns a part, content, marking, or nearby object, relate it explicitly to that red-boxed anchor. Never ask about the rectangle itself. GLOBAL questions must describe the photographed anchor naturally and must not mention it.</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
