<section id="A10.SS5" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.5 </span>Joint crop/full-image audit and rewriting</h3>

<section id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">EDGE_REWRITER</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are the crop-boundary auditor and question rewriter of a visual-QA data pipeline.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">BACKGROUND — WHY THIS STAGE EXISTS:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">The pipeline writes fine-grained QA about one anchor object. Every earlier stage saw ONLY a crop taken around that anchor: a describer captioned the crop, and a question writer turned caption facts into a crop-local question plus a full-image question. Neither could see past the crop’s four edges, so two recurring failures escape them:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">1. INCOMPLETE ANSWER CLAIM: the object or inscription carrying the answer continues beyond the crop boundary, and the recorded answer silently claims to be the complete text or a whole-object attribute when it is not (a sign whose top line sits above the crop; a hull that runs past the edge with more markings).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">2. REFERENT AMBIGUOUS IN THE FULL IMAGE: the referring phrase picks exactly one thing inside the crop but matches several things in the full photograph (three white signs on the same wall; a second red inscription on the same hull).</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">You are the first stage that sees BOTH views, so these become direct observations for you. Downstream, independent solver models will answer the crop-local question seeing only the crop, and the full-image question seeing only the full photograph. Your goal: an honest, careful solver in EITHER view must arrive at exactly the recorded answer. Rejecting a question throws away everything already spent creating it, so PREFER RESCUING a question with a bounded rewrite over dropping it — but never rescue one at the cost of truthfulness.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">INPUTS:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">Image 1 is the crop. A cyan box labeled C1, if present, marks the already-certified unique referent of the crop-local question; a thin red rectangle, if present, marks the anchor. Both are annotations, never scene content.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">Image 2 is the FULL photograph with a red rectangle marking where the crop was taken. Use it to see what continues beyond the crop and what else in the scene matches the question’s wording. Image 2 may be lower-resolution: use it to detect continuation and count referent matches, not to read new text.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">THE QA UNDER AUDIT:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">anchor: "{anchor}"</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">question_type: {question_type}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">global question (full-image solvers) EN: {question_en}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">global question ZH: {question_zh}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">crop-local question EN: {crop_question_en}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">crop-local question ZH: {crop_question_zh}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">recorded answer: {answer}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">mechanical OCR contract (null for non-OCR): {ocr_constraint}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">caption evidence sentence: {evidence}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">AUDIT PROCEDURE:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">A. CONTINUATION: in Image 2, does the object or inscription that carries the answer visibly continue beyond the crop rectangle in a way that could add to or change the answer as the question words it? For an OCR question, also check inside the crop whether the inscription’s own host is cut or occluded near the text so the text may continue out of sight. A cut-off host is harmless when the question only asks about a bounded part that is fully visible.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">  THE BURDEN IS ON ’false’. Reaching the crop border IS continuation unless you can point to the reason it is not. Answer false only when you can name what bounds the host on that side — its own frame, edge, corner or end, visible INSIDE one of the two views — or when Image 2 shows the whole host with nothing further. If the host runs to the border and you cannot see where it stops, that is true, not false, however legible the part you can read: a street plate whose left edge is the crop’s left edge gets read as ’STATION ROAD’ when the plate says ’OLD STATION ROAD’, and a menu board whose bottom is the crop’s bottom shows two of its five lines. Both look complete. Being able to read what is visible is not evidence that nothing else is there.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">  Answering true does not condemn the QA — narrow_semantic rescues it by re-scoping to a sub-block you CAN see whole (’the line nearest the arrow marker’, ’the bottom word’). Prefer that rescue over a confirm you cannot justify.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">B. UNIQUENESS: read each referring phrase of the GLOBAL question and count what it matches in Image 2; read the CROP question and count matches in Image 1. A locator difference that a careful solver would treat as decisive (unique attachment, position, or size wording) counts as disambiguation; a bare category plus color usually does not.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">   For an OCR question, ALSO count the text blocks: every separate inscription on the same host that a solver could take to match how the question describes the text (its color, case, or style) is a competing candidate. Judge like a strict solver, not a brand reader: a smaller second line counts; a darker shade of the same hue counts; digits and mixed letter-digit strings count as capital-glyph text; a registration or phone number printed under a brand name is the classic competing block. If more than one block could match, an honest solver cannot know which to read: the wording must single one out by row, size, or position (rewrite), or the QA must be dropped. Never assume the most prominent text is ’the’ text.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">   WEAK TEXT REFERENT RULE: a text referent described only by color and/or letter case (’the red capital letters’) with no size, row, or position qualifier is weak wording. Whenever the host carries ANY other marking — even one you judge too small or too faint to read — prefer a minimal tightening rewrite (add ’the largest’, a row, or a position word) over keep. The tightening costs nothing and makes the question robust to markings at the edge of legibility.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">   Enumerate this audit in the output field other_inscriptions_on_host: one entry per OTHER inscription, print, number, or marking on the same host (empty list only when the host truly carries no other markings). could_match_question_wording=true means a strict solver could take that block as matching the question’s text description. Keeping the question while any entry is true is a contradiction — then you must rewrite (single the target out by row, size, or position) or drop; code enforces this.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">C. COUNT SCOPE (counting questions): the counted set must be closed by visible boundaries; if Image 2 shows the set continuing outside the crop while the question implies a total, the claim is broken.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">VERDICTS:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">- keep: both audits clean; the recorded answer is exactly what an honest solver would give in both views.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.36.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p36" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p36.1" class="ltx_p">- rewrite: a bounded edit repairs the problem — tighten a referring phrase so it is unique in both views, or narrow an OCR claim to a safe span (see OCR SPAN DECISION). Rewrite all four question fields consistently.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.37.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p37" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p37.1" class="ltx_p">- drop: the recorded answer is factually wrong or unverifiable in either view, no crop-visible qualifier can make the referent unique, or a count’s scope is opened by the crop edge. Also drop when a rescue would need information a crop-only solver cannot see.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.38.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p38" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p38.1" class="ltx_p">- COUNT RESCUE BAN: a counting question whose set the crop opens can NEVER be rescued by wording. Adding ’visible’ / ’可见’ or similar makes the crop total and the full-image total differ, so the two views would have different correct answers. Such a question is unfixable: drop it.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.39.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.40" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.40.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.40.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p40" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p40.1" class="ltx_p">REWRITE RULES:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.41.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p41" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p41.1" class="ltx_p">- The recorded answer may NEVER be extended, corrected, or replaced with content you read in Image 2 — you sit downstream of evidence extraction and may only NARROW claims. For a non-OCR question the answer must stay exactly unchanged; you edit wording only. For an OCR question the answer may only shrink to a contiguous part of the recorded sequence.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.42.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p42" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p42.1" class="ltx_p">- CROSS-VIEW LOCATOR ATTRIBUTES: check every attribute the question uses to FIND the target — color, size, material, shape — against both images, including attributes the draft already contained. A sliver visible in the crop routinely misdescribes the whole object in the full photograph: a white sign whose only visible strip sits against an orange panel reads as ’the orange sign’ in the crop and matches nothing (or something else) in the full image. Replace a misleading attribute with one true in both views, or drop when none exists.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.43.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p43" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p43.1" class="ltx_p">- Every qualifier you add must be verifiable inside the CROP (crop solvers cannot see past it) and stay true in the full image. Prefer attachment, nearest-object, part-position, row/line position, or relative-size cues. Never use viewport words (crop, edge, truncated, cut off, visible portion, 画面边缘, 被截断), and never copy answer characters or answer words into any question field.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.44.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p44" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p44.1" class="ltx_p">- Keep the two languages synchronized and keep the global/crop pairing: the global question locates the target for a full-image solver (usually via the anchor); the crop question drops context the crop cannot establish.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.45" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.45.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.45.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p45" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p45.1" class="ltx_p">- Spatial wording in rewrites must obey this contract:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.46.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p46" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p46.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: SPATIAL_FRAME_RULES&gt;&gt;&gt;&lt;&lt;&lt;INSERT: CROP_FRAME_CAVEAT&gt;&gt;&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.47.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p47" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p47.1" class="ltx_p">OCR SPAN DECISION (REQUIRED for every ocr question, in ocr_span_decision; null for non-OCR):</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.48.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p48" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p48.1" class="ltx_p">You MAY change an OCR question’s answer — this is usually the BEST rescue, not a last resort — provided the new answer is a contiguous part of the recorded one. Upstream drafts are often clumsy (a 20-character positional span, or a sequence that silently spans a truncation); your job is to re-scope onto a piece that is easy to refer to and true in both views: the bottom word, the largest line, the top row, or the first few letters. Work through the decisions in this order and pick the FIRST that yields a claim true in both views:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.49.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p49" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p49.1" class="ltx_p">- confirm: the inscription the question asks about is completely visible with no plausible continuation, and the recorded answer is its complete text (or the question already carries consistent span wording). Valid with verdict keep or with a rewrite that only fixed the referring phrase. confirm is FORBIDDEN whenever you observed the inscription’s host cut or continuing at or near the text region — in the crop or in Image 2. Observing continuation and confirming anyway is a contradiction; choose narrow_semantic, demote, or drop instead.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.50" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.50.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.50.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.50.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.50.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p50" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p50.1" class="ltx_p">- narrow_semantic (PREFERRED rescue): re-scope the question to one fully-visible, visually isolable sub-block — the bottom word, the topmost row, the largest line, the group on one panel — whose complete text is a contiguous whole-word part of the recorded sequence; the answer becomes exactly that part (’what is the bottom word on the sign’ -&gt; ’Bakery’ where the recorded answer was ’Old Town Bakery’). A solver reads such a unit naturally, with no character counting. Identify the sub-block ONLY by visual properties (position, size, row, color of its panel), never by quoting its text.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.51" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.51.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.51.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.51.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.51.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p51" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p51.1" class="ltx_p">  THE SUB-BLOCK MUST BE CLOSED ON THE CUT SIDE. A sub-block is only ’fully visible’ if every one of its own boundaries is inside the crop, and the boundary that matters is the one facing the cut. When the host is cut on its LEFT or RIGHT, a row or line runs straight into that cut and is not closed, so ’the lower line’, ’the word at the top of the sign’, ’the largest word on the second row’ and any other row- or band-based selector is invalid there — pick a unit bounded away from the cut instead (a word whose far side is clear space, the block on one whole panel). When the host is cut at the TOP or BOTTOM, rows away from the cut are fine and a column is not. A size superlative (’the largest word’) over a unit that continues out of view is a claim about text you cannot see. If no closed sub-block exists, use demote_first / demote_last or drop; do not narrow onto an open one.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.52" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.52.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.52.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.52.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.52.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p52" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p52.1" class="ltx_p">- demote_first / demote_last: for the cases narrow_semantic cannot express — no whole word is fully safe, but a clean sub-word boundary fragment is (only ’SUR’ of a longer word is clearly visible). Ask for exactly the first/last k alphanumeric characters of the recorded sequence, with 3 &lt;= k &lt;= 7 — solvers must COUNT the characters, so a larger k turns reading into error-prone counting and is mechanically rejected. Use demote_first when the text’s beginning boundary is visibly real and continuation risk is at the end; demote_last in the mirror case. CROSS-VIEW SPAN AGREEMENT (mandatory): before choosing k, read the same characters in Image 2 — every one of the k characters you keep must be identical in the crop and in the full photograph. A recorded sequence stitched together across a truncation (two cut lines read as one string) diverges from the real text at the stitch, and any k that reaches the stitch makes the answer wrong for full-image solvers: choose the smallest stable k (&gt;= 3) that stays strictly before the divergence, and if even 3 agreeing characters do not exist, demote is unavailable. Both English question fields must contain the explicit k right beside first/last (e.g. ’the first 3 characters’), and the Chinese fields must mirror it (e.g. “前3个字母数字字符”). The answer is that exact span with its original spacing and punctuation preserved.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.53" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.53.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.53.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.53.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.53.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p53" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p53.1" class="ltx_p">- SHORT ANSWERS: an answer of fewer than 3 alphanumeric characters cannot be narrowed any further, so it survives only as confirm with no continuation anywhere at that text. If the inscription continues out of view (or its host is cut at the text), a 1-2 character recorded answer is a fragment of something longer: drop it rather than re-scoping the question onto that fragment — code rejects such a rescue either way.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.54" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.54.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.54.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.54.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.54.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p54" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p54.1" class="ltx_p">- Drop an OCR question only AFTER checking that no narrowing exists: neither a whole-word sub-block (narrow_semantic) nor a 3-7 character boundary span (demote) yields a claim true in both views. A recorded answer being wrong AS A WHOLE does not justify drop when a narrowed part of it is still exactly right.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.55" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.55.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.55.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.56" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.56.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.56.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.56.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.56.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p56" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p56.1" class="ltx_p">Do not transcribe scene text in reasons beyond what the recorded answer already contains. Return strict JSON only:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.57" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.57.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.57.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.57.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.57.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p57" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1.p57.1" class="ltx_p">{"continuation_beyond_crop": true|false, "full_image_referent_matches": &lt;integer count for the global question’s referent in Image 2&gt;, "crop_referent_matches": &lt;integer count in Image 1&gt;, "other_inscriptions_on_host": [{"description": "where/what kind of marking, WITHOUT transcribing it", "could_match_question_wording": true|false}] (for non-OCR questions use []), "verdict": "keep|rewrite|drop", "ocr_span_decision": "confirm|narrow_semantic|demote_first|demote_last"|null, "rewrite": null|{"question_zh": "...", "question_en": "...", "crop_question_zh": "...", "crop_question_en": "...", "answer": "..."}, "drop_reason": null|"concise reason", "reason": "concise image-specific audit reason"}</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>

<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.6 </span>Crop, full-image, and blind answering</h3>

<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Look at this image and answer the question with a single short value (a number, a color, a text string, or a few words). No explanation.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

<section id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">CROP_VQA_ANCHOR_MARKED</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">The thin red selection rectangle is an artificial locator identifying the photographed anchor selected by the pipeline. A crop-local question may refer to the object inside the red rectangle, its parts, contents, markings, or directly related nearby objects. Use the rectangle only to resolve that reference rather than unmarked same-category objects. Never treat the rectangle itself as photographed content or as the requested answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

<section id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">CROP_OCR_VQA</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Look at this image and answer the OCR question by transcribing only the requested text or character span. Preserve character order and do not infer characters that are not clearly visible. If the requested text is not clear, answer exactly: unknown. If the question asks for exactly N characters or letters from a specified position, return exactly N alphanumeric characters in normal reading order: mechanically take the final N for a last/rightmost/ending-N question or the first N for a first/leftmost/beginning-N question. Spaces and punctuation do not count toward N. Do not return the complete visible word or any extra character. Check that the response contains exactly N characters before answering. Return the answer only, with no explanation.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px3.p1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Question: {question}</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>

<section id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">CROP_OCR_VQA_ANCHOR_MARKED</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px4.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
