</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">For ordinary VQA, judge semantic equivalence in the context of the question; extra location or object context is harmless when it does not change the requested answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.18.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.18.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">Think through the comparison internally. Output exactly one tag and nothing else:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;verdict&gt;yes&lt;/verdict&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">or</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px8.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">&lt;verdict&gt;no&lt;/verdict&gt;</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">OCR_ANSWER_EQUIVALENCE</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are judging whether a candidate OCR response correctly answers the exact question. Judge visual content, not answer-only formatting.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p2" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p2.1" class="ltx_p">Question: {question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Reference answer: {reference}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Candidate response: {candidate}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS6.SSS0.Px9.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Apply every positional and length constraint in the question. In particular, if it asks for the first/leftmost/beginning or last/rightmost/ending N characters and the candidate gives a longer transcription, mechanically take the first or final N alphanumeric characters from that transcription before comparing it with the reference. An explanation is allowed when its transcription and stated answer are mutually consistent. Do not say yes merely because the reference text appears somewhere in an unrelated explanation. If the response gives conflicting transcriptions or answers, or the derived requested span differs by any extra, missing, reordered, substituted, or accented character, say no. Ignore only letter case and superficial spacing or punctuation. Reply with exactly one word: yes or no.</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS7" class="ltx_subsection">
<h3 class="ltx_title ltx_title_subsection"><span class="ltx_tag ltx_tag_subsection">J.7 </span>Multi-source distractors and MCQ verification</h3>

<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">FULL_DISTRACTOR_CLUSTERING</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are a conservative semantic auditor constructing multiple-choice distractor candidates from repeated full-image VQA responses. You do not see the image and must not decide which answer is visually true. Do all semantic normalization and clustering yourself; the caller only validates IDs and counts support mechanically.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">The caller has already removed responses judged equivalent to the reference and responses that are literally just ’unknown’. Some remaining responses may still be verbose abstentions, conflicted answers, or judge errors. Audit them conservatively rather than assuming every input is a usable distractor.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">First infer the exact answer slot requested by the question: for example count, OCR string, time, color, material, object identity, action, or spatial relation. Then audit every response independently.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">Response rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.8.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">1. committed means the response ultimately selects exactly one concrete answer. Extract the final selected answer even if it follows reasoning or an explicit self-correction.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.9.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">2. abstain means the response ultimately says unknown, unclear, unreadable, cannot determine, or otherwise declines to answer. Classify it as abstain even if it mentions speculative possibilities.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.10.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">3. conflicted means it leaves multiple incompatible alternatives without selecting one. Do not arbitrarily retain one alternative.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">4. For abstain or conflicted, extracted_answer and cluster_id must be null.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">Clustering rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">5. Cluster committed answers only when they are interchangeable answers to this exact question. Normalize spelling, morphology, number words, abbreviations, and harmless surrounding wording semantically.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">6. Do not merge merely related answers. Different counts, actions, times, directions, materials, object identities, or OCR strings are different answers.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">7. relation_to_reference is equivalent only when the cluster would answer this question with the same meaning as the reference. This check remains required because the earlier per-response judge can make mistakes.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.17.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">8. answer_slot_fit is valid only when the cluster supplies the requested kind of answer. A color is invalid for a material question; an explanation is acceptable only when one clean final answer can be extracted.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.18.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">9. canonical_answer must be a concise normalized form of the cluster’s shared meaning. representative_id must name one actual member whose answer supports that canonical form.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">Completeness contract:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">- Process every supplied response ID exactly once.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- Every committed response belongs to exactly one cluster.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.23.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- Cluster member_ids must exactly partition all committed responses.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p24" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p24.1" class="ltx_p">- Never invent, omit, or duplicate an ID.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">- Output one strict JSON object and no Markdown.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">Question type: {question_type}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p28" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p28.1" class="ltx_p">Question: {question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">Reference answer: {reference}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p31" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p31.1" class="ltx_p">Responses:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">{responses}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.34.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p34" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p34.1" class="ltx_p">Output schema:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.1.35.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p35" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px1.p1.p35.1" class="ltx_p">{"answer_slot": "short description of what kind of answer is requested", "responses": [{"id": "F001", "disposition": "committed|abstain|conflicted", "extracted_answer": "answer or null", "cluster_id": "C1 or null"}], "clusters": [{"cluster_id": "C1", "canonical_answer": "concise answer", "member_ids": ["F001"], "representative_id": "F001", "relation_to_reference": "equivalent|different", "answer_slot_fit": "valid|invalid", "reason": "short explanation"}]}</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">BLIND_DISTRACTOR_CLUSTERING</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are a conservative semantic auditor constructing multiple-choice distractor candidates from blind, text-only model responses. You do not see the image. Do all semantic normalization and clustering yourself; the caller will only validate IDs and count support mechanically.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">First infer the exact answer slot requested by the question: for example count, OCR string, time, color, material, object identity, action, or spatial relation. Then audit every response independently.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Response rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.6.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">1. committed: the response ultimately selects exactly one identifiable answer. Extract that final answer even if it is surrounded by reasoning.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.7.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">2. abstain: it says unknown, cannot determine, or refuses to guess.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.8.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">3. conflicted: it leaves multiple incompatible alternatives without selecting one. A phrase such as ’red or blue’ is conflicted when the question asks for one color. Do not arbitrarily keep one option.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.9.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">4. For abstain or conflicted, extracted_answer and cluster_id must be null.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">Clustering rules:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">5. Cluster committed answers only when they are interchangeable answers to this exact question. Normalize spelling, morphology, number words, abbreviations, and harmless extra wording semantically.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">6. Do not merge merely related answers. Running, sitting, reading, and waving are different actions unless the response itself clearly commits to the same one. ALPHA, BETA, and GAMMA are different OCR strings. These are abstract boundary examples only; do not copy them into the result.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">7. relation_to_reference is equivalent only when the cluster would answer the question with the same meaning as the reference.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">8. answer_slot_fit is valid only when the cluster supplies the requested kind of answer. A color is invalid for a material question; an explanation is acceptable only when one clean final answer can be extracted.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">9. canonical_answer must be a concise normalized form of the cluster’s shared meaning. representative_id must name one actual member whose answer supports that canonical form.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p18" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p18.1" class="ltx_p">Completeness contract:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">- Process every response ID exactly once.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">- Every committed response belongs to exactly one cluster.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.21.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p21" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p21.1" class="ltx_p">- Cluster member_ids must exactly partition all committed responses.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.22.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p22" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p22.1" class="ltx_p">- Never invent, omit, or duplicate an ID.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.23.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p23" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p23.1" class="ltx_p">- Output one strict JSON object and no Markdown.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.24.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.25.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p25" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p25.1" class="ltx_p">Question type: {question_type}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.26.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p26" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p26.1" class="ltx_p">Question: {question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.27.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p27" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p27.1" class="ltx_p">Reference answer: {reference}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.28.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.29.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p29" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p29.1" class="ltx_p">Responses:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.30.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p30" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p30.1" class="ltx_p">{responses}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.31.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.32.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p32" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.p32.1" class="ltx_p">Output schema:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px2.p1.1.33.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VLM_DISTRACTOR_GENERATOR</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are a conservative visual multiple-choice distractor generator. You see exactly one {view_name} image. Generate zero to three short candidate answers that are visually motivated yet definitely incorrect for the question’s intended target. The reference answer is immutable and correct. Returning no candidate is better than inventing unsupported content.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Infer the exact answer slot and the semantic core of the reference first. Every candidate must fill the same slot naturally and must differ in that core; changing an incidental adjective does not create a different answer. For object identity, use a genuinely different head noun, not another colored instance of the reference object. For actions, use a concrete visible action rather than clothing, possession, appearance, or posture. For counts, use only a defensible alternate inclusion boundary or nearby same-class group. For spatial/person identity, preserve the requested relation or entity type.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px3.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">A different visible source is positive evidence: for a blue-hat color question, a yellow shirt or another person’s white hat may supply yellow or white. Name the exact source and relation. Do not use world knowledge, generic alternatives, likely/perhaps/resembling evidence, unknown, the reference, or a synonym of it. MUTUAL EXCLUSIVITY: a candidate must be necessarily false whenever the reference is true, and an average viewer must be able to refute it by looking at the image. Never propose a broader or narrower rewording of the reference (stripes when the reference is white stripes, metal when it is stainless steel), a logically nested category (rectangular when the reference is square — every square is a rectangle), or a value so perceptually close to the reference that the image cannot distinguish them (square vs rectangle, circle vs near-circular oval). The thin red rectangle, if present, is an artificial locator and never image content. Rank strongest first, do not pad to three, and output strict JSON only.</span>

<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VISUAL_DISTRACTOR_CROP_RULES</span>.</h4>

<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px4.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Use only information visible in this expanded crop. Prefer a same-property value from another local instance, then another same-type attribute. Do not assume content from the unseen full image.</span>

<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VISUAL_DISTRACTOR_FULL_RULES</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px5.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Use only information visible in the native full image. Borrow from a different object or text region and match the requested answer slot as closely as possible. You do not have access to the zoom crop.</span>

<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">VLM_DISTRACTOR_VALIDATOR</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are an independent conservative visual validator for proposed multiple-choice distractors. You see the same {view_name} image used by the generator. The immutable reference is correct. Evaluate every candidate independently and do not generate replacements. A candidate should be wrong for the intended target but may deliberately borrow a value from a different visible object, attribute, action, count boundary, person, or text region. Do not reject merely because the source is elsewhere.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Infer the exact answer slot and reference semantic core. For scalar color, material, pattern, or orientation, a directly visible value from any source object is allowed. For object identity, reject any candidate sharing the reference head noun/category regardless of color, owner, or instance; accept only a genuinely different object in an analogous relation. For action, accept a concrete action visibly performed elsewhere but reject clothing, appearance, wearing, possession, and static attributes. For counts, require a defensible visible group/boundary. For spatial/person identity, preserve the requested relation/entity type.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">For OCR, independently transcribe the claimed source instead of trusting the evidence description. The candidate must be an exact complete token or a question-licensed first/last-N span of that transcription; the full source may be longer, so PORTUGAL may be supported by LICOR DE PORTUGAL. A one-word question requires one word, and a name question rejects a bare route/count number, but another visible word need not share the target’s real-world meaning. Source color and capitalization affect quality, not whether the answer string itself fits. If the text is too small to read independently, use reject or uncertain.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.7.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.7.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">Accept only when the candidate has the same answer type/granularity, differs from the reference core, is not also correct for the target, has verified visual evidence, uses a valid strategy, and is concise/non-unknown. MUTUAL EXCLUSIVITY IS MANDATORY: ’not equivalent to the reference’ is NOT enough. Reject any candidate that could be true together with the reference — broader/narrower rewordings (stripes vs white stripes), logically nested categories (rectangular when the reference is square), or values the image cannot refute because they are perceptually adjacent to the reference (square vs rectangle, circle vs near-circular oval; classic color pairs: silver vs white or grey, gold vs yellow, beige or cream vs white). The test: could a careful viewer point at the image and say ’definitely not this’? If not, reject. Reject generic, inferred, likely, or world-knowledge evidence. decision=accept requires quality high or medium. Process every ID exactly once and output strict JSON only.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">View: {view_name}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">

</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px6.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
