<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">DISTRACTOR_ONLY_REWRITE</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are editing multiple-choice distractor options. Rewrite ONLY the listed distractors. The reference answer is immutable context: never rewrite it, replace it, include it in the output list, or turn any distractor into the reference answer. You do not see the image.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Question type: {question_type}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Question: {question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Immutable reference answer: {reference}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">Distractors to edit:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">{distractors}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">For each distractor:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.11" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.11.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.11.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.11.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.11.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p11" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p11.1" class="ltx_p">1. Preserve exactly the answer it commits to. The rewrite must remain semantically interchangeable with that distractor for this question.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.12" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.12.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.12.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.12.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.12.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p12" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p12.1" class="ltx_p">2. Make it a concise, natural, standalone answer to the question. Remove reasoning, hedging, redundant framing, and sentence-level filler.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.13" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.13.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.13.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.13.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.13.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p13" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p13.1" class="ltx_p">3. Match the grammatical form and surface style of the immutable reference when useful, without changing the reference itself. For example, if the reference spells a count as a number word, spell distractor counts as number words too.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.14" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.14.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.14.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.14.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.14.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p14" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p14.1" class="ltx_p">4. Never change a count value, time, OCR character sequence, proper name, direction, color, material, negation, object identity, action, or spatial relation. Formatting-only normalization is allowed when meaning is unchanged.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.15" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.15.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.15.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.15.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.15.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p15" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p15.1" class="ltx_p">5. Do not add visual details, combine options, explain why an option is wrong, or mention the image or reference answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.16" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.16.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.16.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.16.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.16.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p16" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p16.1" class="ltx_p">6. If a distractor is already concise, natural, and style-compatible, copy it unchanged.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.17" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.17.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.17.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.17.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.17.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p17" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p17.1" class="ltx_p">7. Process every distractor ID exactly once. Do not add, drop, merge, or reorder IDs. Output strict JSON only.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.18" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.18.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.18.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.19" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.19.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.19.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p19" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p19.1" class="ltx_p">Output schema:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.20" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.20.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.20.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.20.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.1.20.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p20" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px7.p1.p20.1" class="ltx_p">{"distractors": [{"id": "D001", "rewritten_answer": "concise answer", "changed": true, "reason": "brief editing reason"}]}</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
</section>
<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">MULTIPLE_CHOICE_POOL_CURATOR</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">You are the final text-only curator for a visual multiple-choice question. The immutable reference answer is correct. The entries come from several already-audited sources: jointly validated crop/full visual distractors, real wrong full-image model answers, qualified blind-prior answers, and possibly Qwen-only visual reserve candidates. You do not see the image. Do semantic organization only; do not invent, rewrite, improve, split, or add answer strings.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.3.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.3.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Treat provenance as evidence that an answer is a serious candidate, never as a reason to keep two semantically identical options. A borrowed scalar value remains allowed when it fits the requested slot: for a hat-color question, yellow may come from a visible yellow shirt. Infer the exact answer slot from the question and reference. Process every entry ID exactly once. Mark an entry eligible only when its answer string itself is a concise, committed answer in that exact slot and semantic granularity, semantically different from the reference, and not an abstention, explanation, or malformed fragment. Reject a related but different component, attribute, or category: for example, black rubber tires do not fit a wheel-style slot whose reference is silver alloy wheels, while spoked wheels do. Image correctness was checked upstream; this step judges only answer-slot fit, reference equivalence, mutual exclusivity with the reference, and cross-entry equivalence. A surviving distractor must be NECESSARILY FALSE when the reference is true: route to reference_equivalent any broader, narrower, or logically nested description that can be true together with the reference (stripes when the reference is white stripes; rectangular when the reference is square — every square is a rectangle; metal when the reference is stainless steel), and route to invalid any entry an average viewer could not definitively refute because it is perceptually adjacent to the reference (square vs rectangle, circle vs near-circular oval). Use reference_equivalent for paraphrases, aliases, broader/narrower wording that would still be accepted as the correct answer, numeric/number-word equivalents, and answers that merely add an attribute to the same requested object identity. Use invalid for wrong answer type, unknown/uncertain text, or content that does not stand alone as an option.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.5.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.5.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Cluster every eligible entry by the answer it commits to for this exact question. Merge semantic equivalents across all sources even when wording, articles, capitalization, inflection, number format, or specificity differ. Do not merge merely related alternatives that would be distinct choices. Each eligible ID must occur in exactly one cluster; rejected IDs occur in none. Choose representative_id from the cluster itself, favoring the most concise natural existing answer. Never output a new canonical answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">Question type: {question_type}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p8" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p8.1" class="ltx_p">Question: {question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px8.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">Immutable reference answer: {reference}</span>

<section id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9" class="ltx_paragraph">
<h4 class="ltx_title ltx_title_paragraph"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter">MULTIPLE_CHOICE_SOLVER</span>.</h4>

<div id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<p id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1" class="ltx_p"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1.1" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_inline-block" style="width:0.0pt;"> </span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.1.1.3" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p1" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p1.1" class="ltx_p">Answer one multiple-choice visual question from the supplied zoom crop. The global question gives full-scene identity context; the crop question asks about the same target using wording appropriate for this crop. Use the crop question as the direct visual task. Inspect the image carefully and select exactly one displayed option. Do not explain, hedge, list multiple options, or use outside knowledge when the crop provides the answer.</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.2" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.2.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.2.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.3" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.3.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.3.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p3" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p3.1" class="ltx_p">Question type: {question_type}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.4" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.4.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.4.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p4" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p4.1" class="ltx_p">Global question: {global_question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.5.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p5" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p5.1" class="ltx_p">Crop question: {crop_question}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.6" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.6.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.6.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p6" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p6.1" class="ltx_p">Options:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.7" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.7.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.7.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p7" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p7.1" class="ltx_p">{options}</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.8" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.8.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.8.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_pruned_first ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;"></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.9" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.9.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.9.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p9" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p9.1" class="ltx_p">Return strict JSON only, using one supplied choice label:</span>
</span></span></span></span><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.10" class="ltx_text ltx_font_typewriter ltx_inline-block" style="width:345.0pt;">  <span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.10.1" class="ltx_text ltx_verbatim ltx_inline-block" style="width:333.0pt;"><span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.1.10.1.1" class="ltx_inline-logical-block ltx_parbox ltx_align_top" style="width:333.0pt;">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p10" class="ltx_para ltx_noindent">
<span id="A10.SS7.SSS0.Px9.p1.p10.1" class="ltx_p">{"choice": "A"}</span>
</span></span></span></span></p>
